notes.title: Closed Alpha 0.16
notes.content:
We're happy to announce maybe the largest content for the closed alpha so far. It features new events and creatures, and greatly improves the stability and feel of the game. We've listed all new features and changes/fixes below. 

Major Features
[list]
[*] Map Reveal mechanic - some events can reveal new locations on the map
[*] Event Reveal mechanic - some events can reveal new events on the map. 
[*] Three new humanoid races: skeletons, ratmen and ghosts
[*] Two new creatures: Sharkman and Sea witch. 
[*] Contextual captain commands. We added new commands that appear when selecting entities.
[*] Added tending and recovery mechanics as a way to quickly patch up your crew. 
[*] Added NPCs. Events can now give non-controllable passengers and you can get rewards for bringing them to their destination. 
[*] 
[/list]

[*] Cower job. Unarmed characters will flee when hostiles get nearby.

[*] Changed

[*] Optimized map generation

notes.title: Closed alpha 0.15.1026 - major release
notes.content:
We're happy to announce a new major update for Cursed Crew adding survival and weather mechanics. 

[h2]Major Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added morale. Morale indicates the crew's contentment and mental fortitude under the captain's leadership. It is impacted by positive/negative experiences and can lead to faster working crew when it's high, or bad things like mutiny when its low. 
[*] Added hunger and rations. Characters now need to eat and will starve otherwise. We added a ration system that allows the configuration of what each crewmember is allowed to eat and what should be cooked. 
[*] Added sleep. Characters now need to rest, or otherwise their morale drops quickly and they'll work slower. 
[*] Weather system. Added new system that regulates weather ranging from light drizzles to thunderstorms and fog. 
[/list]

[h2]Additional features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added stove. This building is used for cooking meals. 
[*] Added rations. Rations can be configured for each crewmember and determine the food types they're allowed to eat and under which conditions. 
[*] Added fishing spot. You can now designate spots where your crew can fish. Fishing can only be done when the weather allows it. 
[*] Added hammock. A comfy place to sleep. At least better than sleeping on the deck.  
[*] Added sleeping spot. Used for designating where your crew sleeps on the deck. 
[*] Added 'start combat' cutscene. When combat starts, the camera will briefly fly over the enemy ship so you can inspect their loadout. 
[*] Added 6 food ingredients.  
[*] Added 1 beverage
[*] Added 3 meal types.
[*] Added tag system that shows properties of certain items like 'cooking ingredient', 'healthy' etc. 
[*] Restructured building menu. 
[*] Added Nava ship: a new tiny ship design used by the enemy. 
[*] Added meta event system. This system can trigger minor events (non-text-based ones) that happen while you're playing (like a sudden change in weather, or a group of dolphins swiming by). 
[*] Waves now dynamically change corresponding to the weather type. 
[*] Calm waves are retextured with a color that's closer to the other wave types.
[*] Certain events now have a 'time cost'. Picking options that would realistically take a few hours set the time forward (statuses like hunger/morale change when skipping ahead in time). 
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Rebalanced loot pools. Raw resrouces are more common now. 
[*] Rebalanced traders. Trading is more beneficial for the player now, without allowing any exploits. 
[*] All explosions now cause area damage. 
[*] Explosions can damage structures like cannons now. 
[*] Explosions can trigger explosives. 
[*] Rebalanced explosion damage
[*] Rebalanced building construction times and made sure progress is saved.
[*] Some general performance improvements 
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Many small UI fixes
[*] Can now properly escape to the pause menu in the world map. 
[*] Multiple issues with conflicting keybinds. 
[*] Issues when multiple 'fade to black' events happen at the same time
[*] Status effect durations not being saved properly, potentially causing permanent status effects. 
[*] Stockpiles not occupying space
[*] Crabs reserving jobs they shouldn't reserve.
[*] Pausing the game didn't pause sounds. 
[*] Spyglass minimap not disappearing when fleeing
[*] Deconstructing not returning resources
[*] Some widescreen resolution issues
[*] Game time halting after picking route
[*] Explosion below deck caused by event causing wrong hull breach
[*] Several issues with waves
[*] Gunpowder count of cannons not saving
[*] Many more small fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Closed alpha v0.14.0965 - Major update
notes.content:
Hey folks! We're proud to present Closed Alpha v14, which adds crafting, amongst many other nice features. With crafting we aim to make the time between events a lot more interesting. Calling this a 'crafting' only update wouldn't do it justice though. We added a lot of other new features that should greatly improve the experience with the game, and we fixed a ton of bugs. Check out all changes below. 

[h2]Major features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Crafting. The player can now craft items and cannons at the Crafting Bench and Smithy, two new buildings we've added.
[/list]

[h2]Additional features/changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added new selection system. Left clicking something opens up a context panel showing valuable info about the selected entity. This panel is also used to open context menus like the stockpile dialog and the crafting UI. 
[*] Added UI for speed controls, allowing you to change the game speed without the keybinds. 
[*] Added Smithy building. Used for crafting metal related recipes, like cannons and cannonballs. 
[*] Added Crafting Bench building. Used as a general purpose crafting station. 
[*] Added gunpowder. This resource explodes on being hit by cannonballs, and can catch fire. Cannons now need to be loaded with gunpowder. 
[*] Schematics. Obtaining and using a schematic unlocks recipes for crafting. 
[*] Added barriers. These constructions can be placed on your ship to protect anything behind them. They can be used as cover, and also to protect your gunpowder storages.
[*] Added new Crab creature. They will sometimes take a ride on your ship. They can spawn as either neutral, hostile, or friendly. Hurting them will turn them hostile. 
[*] Added Two crab related events.
[*] Added new materials: Reinforced wood, rope, mechanical parts, refined metal, gunpowder. 
[*] Reworked materials. They now have new stack graphics that don't depict specific counts. This gives us much more flexibility when creating crafting recipes. 
[*] Add hull patches. If hull breaches are repaired, they'll now be repaired with hull patches, taking away half the damage to your ship's health pool. To fully repair hull patches, either visit a port, or use reinforced wood. Repairing hull patches takes much longer than placing them.
[*] Added small and large water leaks. 
[*] Better looking flag pole for caravel and small ship. 
[*] Rebalanced all game sounds. Better scaling for volume settings. 
[*] Changed weapon rendering so that weapons can now overlap things like railings and barriers when aimed. 
[*] Improved nudging system so that ship encounters don't take ages when ships have very minor speed differences. 
[*] Rebalanced all resource costs.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] In-game UI elements being visible on the wrong floors. 
[*] Ambient sounds not being applied globally. 
[*] Issue allowing the player to get out of bounds. 
[*] Visual issue with ropes still showing despite being inside.
[*] Visual issue when loading save from below deck. 
[*] Ghost ship turning invisible. 
[*] Certain events that give more crew no longer spawn when you reach a certain crew limit. 
[*] Wind direction not being affected properly by ship direction. 
[*] Soft lock when loading a save that was created just after character creation (before picking a route). 
[*] Several issues causing boarding hooks to be not throwable. 
[*] Game soft locking because it's not going out of a forced pause state in specific circumstances. 
[*] Pick up animation fixes. 
[*] Fixes related to weapon aiming getting stuck. 
[*] Traders having a deal-o-meter below 50%, allowing you to exploit them for infinite resources. 
[*] Lots of other small fixes. 
[/list]

notes.title: Closed Alpha v0.13 (new major update)
notes.content:
Hey Folks! We're excited to announce the biggest closed alpha update yet! 

The key feature of this update is world map travel. We added a system that lets you pick your route on the world map, with the goal to reach the final boss of the game. For this we also added a boss, the Flying Dutchman, but that's still a work in progress (so don't expect a very balanced encounter yet ;)). 

We also completely overhauled the ship maneuvering system, by giving you more direct control over how the ship is steered. You now can give direct steering orders like 'hard-a-port' (a full 180 degree turn), and you can see how your ship moves on a mini map. We think this offers the player more direct control over how combat plays out. In line with this, we also gave the captain more responsibilities during combat (see the change list below). 

We're really convinced this update is a key step in the right direction, but are also aware there's still a long road ahead. While this update adds the world map mechanics, it doesn't add a lot of content yet to fill this world. notes.content:

notes.title: Closed Alpha v0.12.0828
notes.content:
Hey guys. We're proud to present another update for the Cursed Crew Closed Alpha. This update comes with a lot of changes regarding to the close combat. Weapons are now equippable (and are spawned as loot) and we completely revamped how melee and ranged weapons work. With these changes, the boarding phase should feel a lot better. We also made sure that combat doesn't drag out as long anymore by making a couple of important tweaks to the ship navigation AI. Check out the list below which lists all of the changes (that we didn't forget to write down). 

[b]New close combat system [/b]
[list]
[*] Weapons are equippable instead of attached to you. They're found as loot and traders sell them. 
[*] Weapons now have unique properties including : swing speed, reload time, number of projectiles, and more. 
[*] Weapons have unique abilities, including knockdown, double swing, riposte, extra damage
[*] Parry system added
[*] Melee weapons can crit
[*] Melee animations are now fully directional. Instead of having a fixed animation for east/west/north/south, the animation is adjusted to strike exactly in the diraction you're aiming at.
[*] Characters can now windup and aim melee attacks. 
[*] Weapons can have unique animations (for instance, a dagger has a stab animation).
[*] Reloading is added to ranged weapons.
[*] Ranged weapons have new aim system that automatically pans the camera while aiming.
[*] New animatinos for ranged attacks, including a reload animation, aim animation and a recoil animation. 
[*] New captain commands for ordering crew how to handle close combat. This included a defensive and aggressive stance, and a melee and ranged stance.
[*] Directional attack animation for floating skulls. Their attacks are now much more accurate.
[*] Items like bombs equippable. Crew automatically throw bombs to enemies if they have a bomb equipped. 

[/list]
[b]Other changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Characters now have health bars that show when a character gets hit. Enemy health bars are always shown. 
[*] Ranged and melee combat AI changed. Combat should now be more spread out and less clustered.
[*] Reward dialog shows which crewmembers died during a fight. It also gives back any of their weapons. 
[*] Your crew defaults to a defensive stance. You need to order them explicitly to enter enemy ships when boarding, or set them to aggressive if you want them to board.
[*] Enemy ships now never kite you when you're out of ammo, instead they'll approach or flee.
[*] Having maneuver initiative now has much more impact on the ships relative speeds. This makes it easier to approach ships or to move away from them if you have initiative.
[*] Player gets more starting resources. Loot distribution is tweaked to be a bit more forgiving early game. 
[*] Character arms are now fully outlined and several visual issues with them have been solved. 
[*] Updated tutorial for new combat system
[*] Camera bounds are now circular 
[*] Added newly submitted kickstarter characters
[*] Captains have higher health than other characters
[/list]

[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed performance issue with wave particles. Game should run a bit smoother now
[*] Some unroofed areas were marked as roofed, causing several other issues
[*] Deck above player sometimes visible, hiding the player.
[*] Projectiles not showing at the right location
[*] Boarding command sometimes getting stuck in a loop
[*] Characters being wrongly scaled when enemy ship is mirrored
[*] Triple repeater cannon drawing issue
[*] Many other small fixes
[/list]

Changed
- Floating skulls now attack a lot faster and more accurately, making them much more relevant during combat. 
- Water leaks are now automatically prioritized over normal hull breaches for repairing jobs. 
- Swivel gun projectiles have a lower chance to cause breaches, but do more damage to crew and cannons, have higher spread and more projectiles. 
- Rebalanced cannons. Most cannons are now more deadly to crew and other cannons. Cannons or crewmembers being destroyed during the long range combat phase is much more common now. 
- Updated stockpile dialogs with useful QOL features, such as a copy past option, toggle all buttons and an option to set defaults. 
- Added particle + sound effect for cannons that get hit. 
- Added minimu time between shoutouts of a single character. 
- Added right click option for cancelling designations. 
- Window is now resizeable when playing in windowed mode. 

Fixed:
- Issue causing cannon projectiles to miss crew and cannons very often. 
- Boarding hook ropes sometimes not cleaning up properly, causing issues. 
- Ship rope pull not resetting after encounters, causing consecutive ships to be pulled towards your ship very quickly if you destroyed a ship that roped your ship. 
- Floating skulls not attacking accurately. 
- Characters getting stuck near a mast when the enter mast job is cancelled in specific cases. 
- Stockpile dialog causing stutters, and glitching sometimes while scrolling through it.
- Auto add newly discovered setting not working in stockpile dialog. 
- Characters idling for a while after bringing repair resources. 
- Lighting not being applied on water splashes and debris particles. 
- No crewmate on helm debuff sometimes not removed after loading a save and manning the steering wheel. 
- Harpoons not attaching at the correct position, especially on high game speed or low framerates. 
- Projectiles not always colliding when expected. 
- Cannot deconstruct brazier or put other designations on it. 
- Characters not rotating correctly just after loading a save. 
- Time of day not always being saved. 
- Cannot throw bombs to other ship. 
- Issues with volume not always being consistent, especially for UI.

notes.title: Closed Alpha v0.11.0759: loading screens + Kickstarter characters + many fixes
notes.content:
This small update should further improve the game's stability. There are still some issues we're tracking, so stay tuned for more updates like these. As the game is getting more and more stable, we'll focus more and more on adding new content/improving the game further. 

Any playtesting and especially bug reporting is greatly appreciated!

[b]Changed/added[/b]
[list]
[*] Tweaked player AI so your crew only jump on an enemy ship when you order them to do so. Should make combat less chaotic. 
[*] Added loading screens
[*] Added progressive loading. Loading the game should be smoother now. 
[*] Added all characters submitted by Kickstarter backers to the game. 
[*] Added secret easter egg to character picker. 
[*] Reduced loading times and saving times. The hickup you get when an enemy ship spawns in should also be shorter
[*] Added steering wheel to small ship
[*] Tweaked cannon placement points. They now match with pre-spawned cannons. Rebalanced how many cannon points each ship has. 
[*] Added more default lights to Caravel and Cog
[*] Tweaked volume of character voices. 
[*] Items on the ground no longer block placement of cannons. 
[*] TradeManager selling placed cannons before those in crates
[*] Added option to change voice in Character Editor
[*] Default Role is no longer editable
[*] Changes to role manager will now persist across games. 
[/list]

[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed game getting stuck in a black screen after finishing an encounter and clicking the continue journey button (really this time!). 
[*] Characters sometimes getting stuck before doing an animation that only has an east/west orientation. Happened mostly with repairing and firing cannons. 
[*] Continue journey button stuck in disabled mode, causing the game to soft lock. Happened mostly in high game speeds or with low framerate
[*] Captain not always yelling commands. 
[*] Transparent effect not being removed when an enemy ship sinks on your screen. Causing a big hole in the sea. 
[*] Hauled resources being invisible when carried to an invisible floor. 
[*] Sails still showing when upper decks are invisible when zoomed out far enough. 
[*] RoleManager will no longer display an entry for the Player Captain
[*] Character Editor not validating names

notes.title: Closed Alpha v0.11.735 - Saving/Loading + Many fixes!
notes.content:
We're proud to announce the 0.11 version of the closed Alpha of cursed crew! The main focus of this update is adding saving/loading, and improving the stability of the game. As you can see below, this update comes with lots of fixes. In general, the game should be a lot more bug free, but we still have some tracked issues that aren't fixed yet, but none of them are game breaking. If you encounter some issues, please report them. Enjoy this update!

We're currently working on loading screens, and on adding in the Kickstarter ordered characters. These features didn't make this build, but they'll be added soon. 

Changes/additions:
[list]
[*] Games will now autosave after each encounter.  You can continue a save from the main menu, however only 1 game can be saved at a time.
[*] Saves are deleted upon game over.
[*] Right clicking crates will immediately begin placing them.
[*] Added key prioritization.  Input events will no longer share multiple actions per event, and will only perform 1 at a time.  (ie. right clicking a cannon will no longer issue a goto job on top of displaying the dropdown menu)
[*] Reworked Character Editor UI
[*] Reworked Role Manager UI
[*] Added option for changing the captain's voice in the character editor
[*] Disabled rocks in the sea. They were aesthetic only and caused some clipping issues.  They will be re-added at a later time
[*] Dropdown menu on right clicking now only displays for multiple job options.  If only 1 option is available, job will be immediately assigned.
[*] Added designations for resources, masts and helm. 
[*] Improved character movement with better nudging system that prevents the captain from getting stuck on objects. 
[*] Added transitioning for changes to ship speed, rather than immediate.
[*] Increased hauling speed
[*] Removed crates from enemy ship generation.
[*] Optimized world loading and ship spawning. 
[*] Changed carrack floor mask so stairs connect more cleanly with the upper castle. 
[/list]


Fixed: 
[list]
[*] Cannons not always registering colliders with the ship. This made it impossible to deconstruct them. 
[*] Transition to loot screen getting stuck in certain circumstances, especially on fast machines. 
[*] Character sometimes clipping with ship boundaries, causing the pather to get stuck (causing low fps and other issues). 
[*] Resources drawn slightly higher than their actual positions
[*] Some entities occupying more space than appropriate for their size (especially hull breaches).
[*] Jobs registering too late upon creation, resulting in crewmates not immediately beginning the next job and instead going idle.
[*] Characters avoiding the resources they're carrying leading to odd paths while hauling. 
[*] Deconstruct designator not rendering on stockpiles.
[*] Various issues with UI on Ultrawide monitors
[*] Various fixes to designators and job behavior. 
[*] Player sometimes colliding with stairs when using WASD movement
[*] Framerate affecting movement speed, especially on high game speeds or with fast characters. 
[*] Music playing twice at startup. 
[*] Captain command animation not being cancelled when the captain is moving. 
[*] Character portraits not clipping hairs properly when characters are wearing hats. 
[*] Interrupting jobs on stairs let characters interact with things before pathing to them. 
[*] Trade Manager not allowing selling the full stack of any item
[*] Layering issues with characters and face details.
[*] Camera failing to reset after ship sinking animation.
[*] Input fields having no limit, allowing extremely long captain/ship names. 
[*] Several errors that didn't impact the game in a noticeable way. 
[*] Enemy sea not always drawing correctly, causing ships to clip through waves. 
[*] Characters becoming invisible when zooming while switching floors. 
[*] Status icons not updating properly on startup. 
[/list]

notes.title: Closed Alpha v.10.772
notes.content:
Hi guys. We just pushed a quick patch for some game breaking issues that some of you have been experiencing. The biggest issue was that due to language settings on some of your operating systems, decimal numbers in the game were parsed differently. Some numbers were a factor of 10 higher than what  they were supposed to be. This caused ships to be hilariously fast, and broke a whole lot of other things. 


Update notes: 
- Fixed parsing issues that caused decimal numbers to be parsed differently on some operating system configurations. 
- Fixed return and play game button in ship picker to go off-screen for users with widescreen monitors. We still need to optimize the game a bit more for wide screen monitors, but at least it should be playable now. 
- Made right click menu less sensitive to closing when the mouse is away from it. 
- Fixed 'no hat' option not working in character picker.
